companion.title: Companion Plugin
companion.subtitle: Control PlayWall from Bitfocus Companion, e.g. with a Stream Deck.
companion.unavailable: No plugin is available yet for the current version {version}.
companion.versionNote: The Companion plugin version must always match the PlayWall version. If the versions differ, no connection is established.
companion.features:
Control pads (play / stop)
Switch pages in PlayWall. A setting lets page selection work independently of PlayWall.
Change the volume in steps of 5% or 10%
Stop all pads instantly with one button
Button presets and variables for flexible use
companion.steps:
Download the Companion plugin.
In Companion, open "Modules" and add the PlayWall plugin via "Import module package".
Under "Connections", add the connection to PlayWall. If PlayWall and Companion run on the same computer, the default settings can be kept.
companion.connection:
IP address and port of the PlayWall server
Reconnect automatically when the connection drops
Page changes synchronous with, or independent of, the PlayWall client
companion.presets:
Pad: presets for positions 1 to 100
Pages: presets for pages 1 to 20, plus "previous page" and "next page"
Volume: louder and quieter in 5% steps
Stop all pads
companion.variables:
$(playwall:pad_name_1), $(playwall:pad_name_2) … name of the pad at that position on the active page
$(playwall:pad_status_1), $(playwall:pad_status_2) … status of the pad at that position
$(playwall:page_name_1), $(playwall:page_name_2) … name of the respective page
$(playwall:page_active) … position of the active page
$(playwall:current_volume) … current volume
